headline: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Drones and Missiles as Yemen Fighting Continues
summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted drones and missiles as military conflict with Yemen's Houthis continues in the region.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's leading crude oil exporter; security incidents near its borders can elevate geopolitical supply premiums.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Hostilities involving Saudi Arabia raise concerns over potential energy infrastructure damage and transport disruptions.

why_moved: Armed confrontations and missile interceptions over Saudi airspace heighten regional geopolitical risk premiums across global oil markets.
